summary: Owner pre-empts the phase-6 growth trigger: build the trimmed AST-graph slice now, scenario corpus first.
observation: The blueprint defers Phase 6 until impact sets are measurably too coarse. That trigger has not formally fired: no validator over-selection or context budget blowout has been recorded as a miss. The owner is pre-empting it deliberately, on accumulated evidence rather than a single recorded failure.

evidence.detail: First full census (count 162, the whole pool) found 2 real defects the manifests did not predict: a latent AttributeError (settings.CHANNEL_ENCRYPTION_KEY referenced in sync_source.py with no Settings field defining it) and datetime.utcnow() calls in agent_session.py against the declared datetime.now(UTC) invariant.

19 declared rules carry check_impl phase-*/manual and are reported as not yet enforced on every run; four of them (three layering/boundary rules and the ORM-migration pairing rule) have waited on the import graph since inception.

A single route file seeds a 5-component blast radius with 21 configuration variables: component-glob granularity cannot distinguish a one-line handler edit from a service rewrite, so validator selection is uniformly conservative.

proposed_action: Trimmed phase-6 slice, scenario corpus first: (1) seed tools/repo_governance/tests/scenarios/ with 3 historical and 4 synthetic scenarios and capture pre-graph impact baselines; (2) build a deterministic Python import/module graph over backend/app via AST (never importing app.*); (3) wire layering-routes-services-repositories, forbidden-dependency-not-taken, thick-domains-expose-a-facade, and a deliberately naive orm-changes-have-migrations pairing check, all remaining advisory; (4) feed bounded reverse-import slices into impact and context with a conservative manifest fallback, and re-run the scenarios as the before/after acceptance evidence. TypeScript AST, centrality, visualizers, community detection, and governance/graph/ activation stay deferred within the phase.
trigger_ref: Phase 6 growth trigger: kernel impact sets measurably too coarse (docs/Fullstack_Agentic_Governance_Blueprint.md, Growth triggers for the deferred phases)
limitations: The orm-changes-have-migrations implementation in this slice will be a file-path pairing heuristic that does not satisfy the rule's own promotion criterion (symbol-level detection); it must stay advisory and never be promoted to blocking in that form.

The graph slice covers backend/app Python imports only; TypeScript, cross-language edges, and dynamic import sites remain unmodeled, and their absence is reported as uncertainty rather than treated as absence of coupling.
